[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec find_zero_pair (numbers : List Int) (start : Nat) (end : Nat) : Bool :=
  match start with
  | end => false
  | _ =>
    let i := start
    let j := (start + 1) % numbers.length
    if sum_i_j i j then true
    else find_zero_pair numbers (start + 1) end

def implementation (numbers : List Int) : Bool :=
  numbers.length > 1 →
  find_zero_pair numbers 0 numbers.length

[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma sum_i_j_self : (i : Nat) → numbers[i]! + numbers[i]! = 0 → numbers[i]! = 0
| 0 h => by simp [h]
| i+1 h => by simp [h]

lemma sum_i_j_symmetric : (i j : Nat) → sum_i_j i j ↔ sum_i_j j i
| 0 j => by simp [sum_i_j]
| i+1 j => by simp [sum_i_j]

lemma find_zero_pair_cases : (numbers : List Int) (start end : Nat) →
  find_zero_pair numbers start end ↔
  (∃ i j, start ≤ i < end ∧ start ≤ j < end ∧ i ≠ j ∧ sum_i_j i j)
| numbers 0 end => by simp [find_zero_pair]
| numbers (i+1) end =>
  begin
    have h := find_zero_pair_cases numbers i end,
    by_cases h_sum_i_j : sum_i_j i (i+1) mod numbers.length,
    { simp [h_sum_i_j] },
    { simp [h] }
  end

lemma find_zero_pair_terminates : (numbers : List Int) → find_zero_pair numbers 0 numbers.length = false
| [] => by simp
| [n] => by simp
| n::n'::numbers' =>
  begin
    have h := find_zero_pair_terminates (n'::numbers'),
    have h_sum_i_j := sum_i_j_self 0 (n = 0),
    have h_sum_i_j' := sum_i_j_self 1 (n' = 0),
    simp [h_sum_i_j, h_sum_i_j', h]
  end

[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation numbers
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_numbers_length : 2 ≤ numbers.length := by
  by_contra
  simp
  linarith
let h_sum_i_j := find_zero_pair_cases numbers 0 numbers.length
simp [h_sum_i_j]
have h_exists_zero := h_sum_i_j.2
simp [h_exists_zero]
simp [spec]
by_cases h_result : result
-- if result is true
simp [h_result]
have h := h_exists_zero
apply And.intro
apply h
-- if result is false
simp [h_result]
have h_not_exists_zero := h_exists_zero.1
simp [h_not_exists_zero]
apply And.intro
refl
apply h_find_zero_pair_terminates
[END]
